caption: A diver stands at the end of a high platform, bends her knees, jumps off, and falls into the pool.

sa.check: A diver stands at the end of a high platform.
The pool is visible below the platform.
The knee bend comes first, then the jump, then the fall.

pc.expect: She rises briefly off the platform and then falls quicker and quicker toward the water.
pc.fail: She slows down on the way to the water; or she hangs in the air below the platform; or she keeps rising from the platform to the top of the frame.

pc.expect: The jump carries her out from the platform, her path curves over into the fall, and she comes down clear of the platform.
pc.fail: She drops straight down against the face of the platform after plainly jumping outward; or she travels backward over the platform in mid-air; or she moves further out the lower she gets, as if pushed.

pc.expect: Once she leaves the platform nothing but the fall changes her course.
pc.fail: She changes direction in mid-air with nothing touching her; or she stops in mid-fall and hangs there; or she gathers speed upward.

pc.expect: Where she enters the water it splashes up and rings spread out from the entry point.
pc.fail: She enters the water and the surface stays flat; or the splash rises before she reaches the surface; or she passes into the water leaving no ripple at all.
pc.precondition: She reaches the water within the clip.

pc.expect: One diver keeps her limbs, her number and her shape, and she does not pass into the platform.
pc.fail: A limb stretches, detaches or vanishes; or she passes through the platform; or a second figure appears on the platform.

pc.expect: Her swimsuit, the platform and the pool surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: Her swimsuit changes colour in mid-air; or the platform changes shape between frames; or the stands behind the pool rearrange.

note: Biomechanics scene: the diver's body is what shows the fall. Technique, form and entry style are not judged; only the direction and order of the motion.
